author: Jamie Kim
subject: Zenara - restaurant edge + network refresh
body:
Attendees: Tamara Bryant (CIO), Erin Foster (Dir IT), Karen Green (Network Eng); Orvane: Jamie Kim, Hao Stewart, Nathan Nakamura

- ~140 restaurant locations + 2 commissaries + HQ in Overland Park. Each site: POS, kitchen display, back-office Cadence Micro, guest Wi-Fi.
- Edge/IoT: walk-in cooler sensors and fryer telemetry, today on consumer-grade gear. Want Mesh SD-WAN edge per site plus Mesh PoE switching, central management.
- DC: vSphere 7 in a colo, Google Cloud for loyalty app + analytics. Backup software is a third-party package on generic disk.
- Procurement: Zenara AP is slow - Tamara warned us "we pay, but we pay late." Net 30 terms on our side.

Actions: Hao - per-site Mesh BOM (SD-WAN Edge 300 + 24-port PoE); Nathan - edge reference design; Jamie - check credit line size with credit dept before we quote 140 sites.

author: Dominic Moore
subject: Zenara AP aging
body: fyi Zenara invoices averaging ~70 days to pay on Net 30. Credit dept says normal for restaurant groups but their line is small, so any order >$75K will likely hold. Also Brooke's Vault order (SO-30203619, $228,114) went in with no PO at all. Plan accordingly.

author: Jamie Kim
subject: SO-30203619 short-pay
body: SO-30203619 ($228,114 - Brooke's Vault DP x1) - booked without a PO; Erin Foster sent one after the fact. Then AP paid the first invoice short by ~$3.1K, citing "quoted price." The quote had expired and we re-priced before booking. First time I've seen them short-pay; flagging for whoever has this next.

author: Min-jun Cook
subject: SO-30203683 booked - credit hold
body:
Lindsey's Strata 300 x2 (SO-30203683, $189,927, PO-2023-5364) went straight to Credit Limit Exceeded. Released after AP paid two invoices.
Related: I approved 38% discount on the Cadence lines in May (SO-30203657) to beat Varenta on the bid - approval email from my manager, not in deal desk (deal desk system was down). Their PO-2023-7175 came in at the 38% number and the order flagged PO amount mismatch. Customer now expects 38% as the standard. Need to document this somewhere.

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Takeover - Zenara Co.
body:
New AO 10/20, inherited from Min-jun Cook with an 11-day gap. No handoff call.
What I found:
- Recurring AP issues: late pays, at least one short-pay in 2022, order holds for credit. Lindsey's Strata order in July (SO-30203683) went on credit hold; Min-jun's last portal order (SO-30203695) has no PO at all.
- Discounts: some Cadence orders at 38%, others at 32%. No deal desk record of the 38% approvals. Customer thinks 38% is their contract rate - there is no contract.
- Competitor: Varenta on client devices, aggressive.
- Contacts: Nathan Reddy (CIO) primary, Laura Okafor (Dir IT Procurement) runs POs, Robert Lopez (AP Mgr) for invoices.
To do: get a pricing agreement in writing so AP stops disputing.

author: Megan Martin
subject: Atlas refresh scoping - ERP + San Antonio DC
body:
Attendees: Joshua Kowalski (Dir Infra), Thomas Choi (Dir Infra), Travis Park (DC Ops), Brandon Sato (Storage Admin); Orvane: Megan Martin (SA), Alicia Watson, Carly Vaughn

Context: ERP migration (cloud ERP + on-prem integration tier) is the driver; cutover planned for January. San Antonio distribution center opened this month and needs local compute.

Scope
- Joshua's original ask: ~25 Atlas hosts across colo + San Antonio. Varenta quoting the same, same as in March.
- Budget reality per Joshua: ~15 nodes (Atlas 240, 2-socket) in this FY, rest next year.
- AI production: menu demand forecasting moving on-prem from GCP - 2 GPU nodes (48GB class) priced as a separate line.
- vSphere 7 -> 8 upgrade with the new hosts; VMware per-core subscription - right-size core counts per node.
- Storage: Strata 300 G4 T4V564N takes the ERP tier; HTX81DY at ~65%, Lindsey to look at expansion.

Decisions: Alicia to quote both 25-node and 15-node versions; target close before ERP cutover.
Actions: Alicia - quotes by 9/10; Megan - rack elevation + VLAN plan (mgmt 110, vMotion 120, storage 130); Carly - check credit line headroom BEFORE we close (lesson learned).

body:
Carly,

Responding to the statement your collections team sent. Our position:
1. Invoices for SO-30203850 and SO-30203854 were paid at the discount on our approved POs. The balance (~$5.9K combined) is disputed and will not be paid until we receive credit memos.
2. Invoices for SO-30203869 are in approval. Our ERP migration freezes new vendor payments and new POs from Dec 15 until cutover (planned Jan 20).
3. Please route all future invoices to ap@zenara.com, not to individual staff.

Regards,
Robert Lopez
Accounts Payable Manager
Zenara Co.

author: Jordan Morris
subject: Internal - Zenara credit hold / deal desk
body:
Attendees (internal): Carly Vaughn, Jordan Morris (TAM, started 12/28), Gavin Sato, Brooke Davis, Alicia Watson, credit dept rep, deal desk

Orders on hold
- SO-30203875 $195,550 Aster 5 x106 - credit hold, PO-2025-7662 (real, cut pre-freeze)
- SO-30203885 $85,455 Strata shelves (Lindsey) - credit hold, PO-2026-1836 (a number Laura reserved in the new ERP - AP can't see it yet)
- SO-30203897 $611,699 Atlas 240 x15 - credit hold, PO-2025-7123 (catch-all blanket, closed in old system)
- Total on hold: $892,704. Plus 0065f00004epmpDAAQ ($253,490) Closed Won with no order, and the San Antonio DC order (~$100K) Carly expects to book next week.

Credit position (per credit rep)
- Credit line $400K (Carly's 2024 note said $350K - credit says it was raised in March 2025). Open AR ~$395K, ~$140K of it 60+ days.
- Even with valid POs, credit will not release ~$890K against a $400K line. Needs paydown + temporary limit increase, or OFS once past-due clears.
- Short-pays: ~$5.9K disputed on two invoices + the 2024 SO-30203704 balance (~$18.8K) never resolved.

Root causes: undocumented 38% discount precedent from 2023; Zenara ERP freeze; PO-2025-7123 used as a catch-all; small credit line for account size.

Decisions
- Deal desk to issue one-time credit memos on disputed short-pays IF Zenara signs a pricing letter confirming 32% standard going forward.
- No releases until 60+ day AR paid. No exceptions approved.

Actions: Carly - pricing letter to Laura Okafor; Gavin - weekly AR call with Robert Lopez; Jordan - align delivery dates once released; Brooke - re-run OFS after paydown.
